csv_project_name: DB for Wayfinging & Gateway Signage System
csv_agency: City of Manchester Economic Development Office
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Manchester is seeking proposals from qualified design-build firms or partnerships to provide comprehensive services for the design and installation of a downtown wayfinding and gateway signage system. The project is intended to support the city s goal of effectively welcoming, guiding, and informing residents, business owners, and visitors through coordinated parking, directional, downtown wayfinding, and gateway signage improvements. The selected team will be responsible for developing a cohesive signage program that enhances navigation, improves visibility and accessibility of existing parking resources, and creates a welcoming and intuitive experience throughout the downtown area. The scope includes planning, design, fabrication, and installation services that reflect Manchester s identity as a vibrant regional hub while improving connectivity, visitor experience, and overall accessibility to key destinations within the city.
